title: UsageSnapshot
description: What the collector (on the dev computer) serves to the Android app. Raw facts only: the app derives status (working / idle / near_limit / limited / stale / unknown). Never contains credentials.

generatedAt.description: When the collector built this snapshot (UTC).

usedPercent.description: 0-100+. May exceed 100 briefly; clamp for display.

resetsAt.description: When this window resets (UTC). Null if unknown.

id.description: Stable id. Extend the enum when adding an agent.

name.description: Display name, uppercase ASCII (pixel fonts are Latin-only).

active.description: Agent did work recently (collector heuristic, ~60 s).

fiveHour.description: Null when the plan has no 5-hour window.

group.description: Optional sub-bucket shown to the user, e.g. the Antigravity model group the numbers belong to.

dataAt.description: When the numbers were measured at the source (may be older than generatedAt, e.g. last Codex session log).

source.description: Which reader produced it, e.g. claude-oauth-usage, codex-session-log, antigravity-local-ls.

error.description: Short machine-readable error if the reader failed (then windows may be null).
